_about: Expert review of Maya Audit cards: one SEO expert's verdict per card, kept as accuracy data (DECISIONS 338, 340). verdict: the expert's (correct, wrong, wording, incomplete); assessment: what the saved evidence showed when checked (agree, right, mostly_right, partly_right, not_supported). follow_up: rules whose verdict was wrong.
source_file: maya-audit-www.enpara.com-2026-11-11-ek-tr İlginay 2. Kontrol.xlsx, Özet, column "İlginay's Not" (an Ek made before fffddad and 1db0ddf)

cards.title: Head'i erken kapatan öğeyi taşıyın
cards.finding: Her file predates fffddad: one High card for 90 pages. The evidence: 2 pages carry robots noindex only after div#blueLightOverlay (High); on 88 canonical, hreflang and title stay in the head (Medium).
cards.fix: Already fixed by DECISIONS 339 (fffddad): "2 sayfa (+88 sayfa: Orta)", why and steps from the evidence.

cards.title: Site haritasındaki hata veren adresleri düzeltin ya da çıkarın
cards.expert_note: Bulgu hatalı, site haritasında var denilen linkler bulunmuyor
cards.finding: All 21 are in crawl.sitemap_urls and each page record says discovered_via sitemap: 12 from /sitemap.xml, 9 from /sirketim/sitemap.xml, read at 12:07:49-12:07:52 UTC on 11 Nov. All https://www., none with a trailing slash. 10 hold Turkish letters the file wrote percent-encoded (Maya keeps letters as written), but the Ek showed them decoded, so Cmd+F in the file finds nothing. The raw <loc> text was not saved; today's sitemap cannot be re-checked offline.
cards.fix: New audits keep each <loc> as written, its line and when the file was read; the Ek shows them ("Site haritasındaki <loc> metni", "<loc> satırı", "Site haritası okuma zamanı"); a saved audit shows the address as Maya kept it (percent-encoded) and the sitemap step's start, marked approximate.

cards.title: H1 etiketi olmayan sayfalara tek bir H1 etiketi ekleyin
Aynı açıklamayı paylaşan sayfalara ayrı açıklama yazın
Bağlantıları doğrudan son adrese verin
cards.expert_note: Sayfa ve ölçülen değer ne veriyor burda bir karışıklık var
cards.finding: The finding is right: "Hesap aç" in the menu of 3 pages links /kredi-musteri/kredi-basvuru, which 302s to /kredi-musteri/ihtiyac-kredisi-hesaplama (200). The Ek put the old address under "Bozuk adres" and the measured value said only "A → B"; on /kredi-musteri/ihtiyac-kredisi-hesaplama itself the redirect ends on the linking page.
cards.fix: Links to an address that redirects to a working page have their own sheet "Yönlendiren bağlantılar": Bağlantının bulunduğu sayfa, Bağlantı verilen (eski) adres, Yönlendirme, Doğrudan verilmesi gereken son adres, and a note when it ends on the linking page; the per-page value says which link goes where.

cards.title: Uzun sayfalardaki bölüm başlıklarını H2/H3 olarak işaretleyin
Marka için sitede tek bir ad kullanın
cards.expert_note: Burda ingilizce sayfasında marka adı değil o sayfa başlığı bu nedenle bu öneri hatalı
cards.finding: Her file predates 1db0ddf. The two other names are page titles copied into structured data: "Homepage" is /en/homepage's <title> (Organization name), "Bankanın güzeli | Enpara" the homepage's <title> (Organization and WebSite name).
cards.fix: 1db0ddf moved it under "Teyit edin"; DECISIONS 340: an Organization/WebSite name equal to its page's own <title> (and given by no other source) is not a brand name. enpara: one name left, no brand finding.

cards.title: Sayfaların gösterdiği bilgiyi yapısal veriyle işaretleyin
cards.expert_note: Yanlış öneri, burdakiler FAQ değil başlık olarak kullanılmış, schema eklenmez
cards.finding: Re-checked the 16 pages from Maya's own records: no question opens and closes its answer (no accordion) and none sits under a heading naming an FAQ; they are paragraphs under ordinary section titles ("Ödeme İste", "ATM'ye Transfer"), question-shaped article headings, and on /bilgi-bankasi 51 article links. The rule needed punctuation alone.
cards.fix: FAQPage only for an accordion (<summary>, <dt>, aria-expanded, a collapse class) or a run under an FAQ heading ("Sıkça Sorulan Sorular", "SSS", "FAQ" ...); a saved audit keeps only pages with an FAQ heading. enpara: 16 → 0, no card.

cards.title: Küçük bağlantı ve etiket tutarsızlıklarını temizleyin
cards.expert_note: Burda öneri olarak yönlenene sayfaları da versek iyi olur
cards.finding: The card named each llms.txt link and where it redirects but not what to do; /sikca-sorulan-sorular ends on /404?aspxerrorpath=... (an error page: the same path answered 404 in the crawl), /enparacom-nedir on /hakkimizda (not measured).
cards.fix: Each redirecting item says what to do: "bağlantıyı şu adrese verin: …" when the end answered, "hata sayfasına gidiyor (404): bağlantıyı kaldırın ya da doğru sayfanın adresini yazın" for an error page, and that the answer was not measured when it was not.
